heroHeadline: Nairobi Traders Shut Down CBD, Tear-Gassed Over KRA Import Duty Hike
heroSubtitle: Small-scale traders from Kamukunji, Gikomba and Eastleigh march on KRA's Times Towers over a container customs benchmark hike from KSh 2.5m to KSh 3.2m, vowing weekly Friday protests as cost-of-living anger that first fueled the Gen Z movement resurfaces beyond it
